title: channel_plan.py: select_channel returns out-of-bounds index for plans with < 3 channels
description: Line 87-88 and 311-312: The formula `n = max(num_channels - 1, 2); return 1 + (h % n)` can return indices 1 or 2 for a 2-channel plan (valid indices 0-1) or 1-channel plan (valid index 0 only). This causes ValueError when frequency() is called. All built-in plans have 8+ channels so this only affects custom plans.
